simple.meaning: פּוּנֹן (Pûwnôn) is a Hebrew word meaning “Punon , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פּוּנֹן (H6325) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 33:42, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פּוּנֹן (H6325) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פּוּנֹן (H6325) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פּוּנֹן (Pûwnôn) / H6325 is traced through Numbers 33:42, Numbers 33:43 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
